About Horizon

Built around the people we work alongside.

Founded in 2012 as a small grants-dependent collective. Now a registered DGR community foundation working across metropolitan and regional Western Australia.

Profile

Who we are.

A community foundation supporting disadvantaged communities across metropolitan and regional Western Australia. Core programs span youth employment, digital literacy for seniors, community health, and emergency relief. Funded through a mix of government grants, corporate partnerships, individual donations, and social enterprise income. Known for genuine grassroots engagement and a collaborative approach that centres community voice.
FACT 01

12 active programs across metro and regional WA

FACT 02

4,200 direct beneficiaries per year

FACT 03

Government grants: 45% of revenue

FACT 04

Corporate partnerships: 30% (Woodside, Wesfarmers, BHP foundations)

FACT 05

Individual giving and events: 15%

FACT 06

Social enterprise (op shops, training café): 10%
